name: Hotel Montana
beschreibung: The Hotel Montana in Telfes im Stubaital is situated in a quiet location at the entrance to the village. The surrounding mountain landscape is characterized by extensive hiking trails and the nearby Skigebiet Stubaier Gletscher. The hotel offers practical amenities including a Restaurant, Sauna, and fitness room. The rooms are functionally furnished and have a balcony with mountain views. Guests can expect accommodation focused on nature and relaxation. The Stubaier Alpen are easily accessible from the hotel. The village of Telfes itself offers places to stop for refreshments and public transport connections.
